public_definitions: The goal is to review the state risk dashboard and open the state risk record that should be routed into the highest-risk priority follow-up workflow.
The comparison scope is the state risk dashboard, which displays the Risk Index of Hazard H for all US states.
The rules are to select the state with the highest risk index from the dashboard and route it into the highest-risk priority follow-up workflow.
